transcript: If you want to lose weight fast, do not chase diets, chase discipline. Your body knows how to change. You only need to remove the things that slow it down. My friend, let me teach you the ancient method that transforms the body in one or two weeks without suffering, without starving, without fighting your nature. Step 1. Walk after every meal. 10 minutes, just 10. This simple habit is more powerful than any modern trick your food moves. Your digestion wakes. Your stomach flattens. Your body begins to burn instead of store. Step 2. Eat within an 8-hour window. Choose your 8 hours. Eat inside them. Fast outside them. This gives your body time to clean, repair, and use stored fat for energy. People call this fasting. In the East, we call it normal life. Step 3. Remove the heavy 3 for 7 days. Take away. Sugar, fried oils, night snacking. When these leave your body, your face looks slimmer. Your belly deflates. Your energy rises. This is why people see results so fast. Step 4. Drink clean water. 1 to 2 liters a day. Do not drink your calories. Do not drown your body in sweet liquids. Clean water cleans the system. Step 5. Eat simple foods. Real food. Rice, vegetables, eggs, fruits, soups, lean protein. Nothing complicated. Nothing pretending to be food. Your body changes fastest when you stop confusing it. If you follow these 5 steps for just 7 days, your body will show you the first signs of transformation in 14 days. You will feel lighter, clearer, and more in control of your shape.
